cover.label: Cover each day
cover.help: How many people must (or may) be on a duty each day.
cover.example: Each day: exactly 2 juniors on Call
cover.words: Each day: at least 1 person on …

limit.label: Limit per person
limit.help: How many times each person may (or must) do a duty per week, month or any run of days.
limit.example: Juniors: at most 7 Call a month (scaled by FTE)

sequence.label: Day-after rules
sequence.help: What may or must follow (or come before) a duty: gaps between calls, no call before leave.
sequence.example: After Call: no Call for the next 2 days

sameDay.label: Same-day combinations
sameDay.help: Codes that can't go together on one day (leave and a shift), or one that needs another.
sameDay.example: Never leave and any shift on the same day
sameDay.words: Never … and … on the same day

together.label: Pairing between people
together.help: Who can't be on together (two Baby MOs), or who needs someone else on with them.
together.example: Baby MO on Call: at least 1 of senior residents or ACs on Call too
together.words: Everyone on …: needs another person on … too

maxRun.label: Consecutive days
maxRun.help: The longest run of days in a row someone may have a duty.
maxRun.example: Everyone: at most 5 days in a row of any shift
maxRun.words: Everyone: at most 5 days in a row of …

requests.label: Honour requests
requests.help: Give people what they asked for (Cr, Pr, Wr) and keep them off what they asked not to do (Nc, NP, Nw).
requests.example: No call (Nc): no Call that day
requests.words: No call (X): give Cardiac that day

spread.label: Share fairly
spread.help: Spread a duty evenly: weekends and public holidays count extra. Always soft.
spread.example: Share Call fairly among juniors (weekends x2, holidays x2)
spread.words: Share … fairly among everyone (a day off adds 0.5 and so does the day before one: Fri 1.5, Sat 2, Sun 1.5)

eligible.label: Only these people
eligible.help: Restrict a duty to some people (OT consultant: seniors only).
eligible.example: Only seniors may do OT consultant

noCallsUntil.label: No calls until their date
noCallsUntil.help: People with a "No calls until" date (People › edit a person) take no calls before it: baby MOs until they pass the test, very new people.
noCallsUntil.example: No calls before the date set on each person
noCallsUntil.words: No … before the "no calls until" date set on each person

postingStart.label: Start of a posting
postingStart.help: No calls in the first days of a posting: a block of days in a row on the same posting, however it started.
postingStart.example: New to ICU: no ICU call in the first 3 days in ICU (calls from day 4)
postingStart.words: no … in the first day of  (from day 2)

standing.label: Standing duty
standing.help: Someone always does a duty on certain days unless they are away (APS every weekday).
standing.example: Pain (APS): Acute pain service every day (weekdays)
